discussion_comments.comment_body: I kept this salt aligned with the existing app-side field encryption format intentionally. The CLI writes provider credentials into the same SQLite store that the dashboard/server reads, so changing to a CLI-only per-install salt would make credentials written by `omniroute setup` incompatible with the existing dashboard/server decrypt path unless the app encryption format is migrated together. I added an explicit code comment documenting that compatibility constraint.

Closed as addressed by `da39e14`. `bootstrapEnv` now fails closed on database inspection errors instead of silently treating them as "no encrypted credentials", which closes the key-generation safety hole.

I reviewed this one and I am intentionally not expanding the check to recursive symlink traversal in this PR. The concrete broken case reproduced here is a top-level standalone `node_modules` symlink that `electron-builder` preserves into `extraResources`, causing the packaged app to resolve dependencies from the build machine path. Nested symlinks inside a real `node_modules` tree are normal package-manager behavior and broad recursive rejection would make this fix noisier and risk false positives beyond the bug being fixed.
